main_text.p: Soldano per secretum nuncium dari: literiq; ipsum admonuit, ut si quietus vivere vellet, illu[?] per insidias necaret. Soldanus acceptis his literis, cum expressa boni Imperatoris imagine, studuit ma-ligno huic monstro gratificari, & se ulcisci de adversario. Sed occasio in castris aut conflictu nunquam obtulit se, ad explendam proditionem Pon-tificiam. Cum vero potitus Hierosolyma exercitum reduceret Cæsar, se curus partiebatur copias in suos ordines, ut eo commodius emensum iter remetiri possent. In Armenia autem, cum semel ex calore solis atque itineris difficultate æstuaret ac sudaret nimium, nihil esse periculi in ea nemorum solitudine ratus, cum paucis equitibus & suo fa-cellano ab exercitu discessit. Non admodum procul, equo descendit, vestes parabat exuere, & ut ipse cum facellano in amne lavaret, ad restinguendum[?] æstum corporis, equites iussit ab amne rece-dere. Ibiq; statim benignus Imperator, equitibus i-gnorantibus, cum suo facellano, ab infidiatoribus capiebatur, ac per nemora abducebatur ad Soldanum. Equites frustra expectabant Imperatorem, quærebant diligenter in alterum usq; diem. Rumor ad exercitum venit, eum esse demersum. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "illu" (macron may be missing) and "restinguendum" (the word is partly run together at the line end). Paragraph breaks: the printed lines show no indents, so the page is set as one continuous paragraph, which continues from the previous page. Long s is printed throughout and is rendered as s. The running head is printed as PONTIFICVM and is corrected to PONTIFICUM under the u/v rule.
